// The stock tics counted on their own, in every literal, short ones too. Ouch 3, For now. 2, Mostly. 1,
// Fair. 2, at 3 AM 4, needs a nap/rest/break 4.
export const COUNT = [
  'Ouch', // ouch
  'ouch, that hurt a lot', // ouch: any case
  'OUCH!', // ouch
  'Wait it out for now.', // for now.
  'For now.', // for now.
  'Mostly.', // Mostly. (case-sensitive)
  'Fair.', // Fair.
  "That's fair.", // Fair.: any case
  'at 3 AM', // at 3 AM
  'at 3:00 a.m.', // at 3 AM
  'at 3 a.m.', // at 3 AM
  'at 3am', // at 3 AM
  'Your wallet needs a nap.', // needs a nap
  'needs a break', // needs a break
  'needs a rest', // needs a rest
  'NEEDS A NAP', // any case
]

// None of these count.
export const NO_COUNT = [
  'slouching on the couch', // not the whole word "ouch"
  'for now, maybe later', // needs the period
  'mostly.', // Mostly. is case-sensitive
  'fair play', // Fair. needs its period
  'an affair.', // and is a whole word
  'at 3 PM',
  'at 30 AM',
  'need a nap',
  'needs a nape', // the last word has to be whole
]
